steps.en: A foreign vehicle is recognised and its notice kept outstanding
steps.id: Kendaraan asing dikenali dan notice-nya tetap outstanding
steps.why_en: The story is removed; the notice is also permanently suspended as foreign from the start.
steps.why_id: Story sudah dihapus; notice juga langsung disuspend permanen sebagai kendaraan asing.

steps.en: Officer updates the driver's details by hand for a foreign-vehicle notice
steps.id: Officer mengubah data driver secara manual untuk notice kendaraan asing
steps.why_en: Staff screen blocks notices that are permanently suspended, which includes foreign vehicles.
steps.why_id: Layar staff memblokir notice yang disuspend permanen, termasuk kendaraan asing.

steps.en: Driver's details can also be furnished through PLUS
steps.id: Data driver juga bisa di-furnish lewat PLUS
steps.why_en: PLUS uses the same check, so a permanently suspended foreign-vehicle notice is refused.
steps.why_id: PLUS memakai pengecekan yang sama, jadi notice kendaraan asing yang disuspend permanen ditolak.

steps.en: The notice then follows the standard driver processing steps
steps.id: Notice lalu mengikuti tahap pemrosesan driver yang standar
steps.why_en: Only the generic furnish stage change exists; the referenced appendix is not available.
steps.why_id: Hanya perubahan tahap furnish umum yang ada; lampiran yang dirujuk tidak tersedia.
